transcript: Speaker A (AI Avatar): वेटेर की इंग्लिश से फ्यूज उड़ा? on_screen_text: waiter ki English se fuse uda... Speak Easy app pe aao... Speakeasy AI. Speak English Easily with Speakeasy. Install Now.
summary: A man expresses embarrassment over his poor English during a date. An AI avatar introduces the Speakeasy app as a private tutor to build speaking confidence, concluding with a call to download the app.
